Every remaining candidate was read by title (and abstract where unclear). include: reports dispersed-spore or cryptospore assemblages of Dapingian-Emsian age from rock samples. include_borderline: probable but unconfirmed (no abstract, mixed marine and terrestrial palynomorphs, or the assemblage is part of a wider study). exclude: ultrastructure, in situ spores only, reviews and syntheses (kept as cross-check sources), Cambrian, Tremadocian-Floian, Carboniferous, Mesozoic, Middle-Late Devonian only, marine palynomorph-only, methods, catalogues, geochemistry. Region is the plan's table (docs/spore-compilation-plan.md section 2): assigned by reading the title and abstract; region_secondary names a second region where the paper spans two. Country keywords are used only as a check. Tibet, Himalaya, Ethiopia and the Falklands count as other Gondwana; Maine and the Gaspe-New Brunswick belt as Laurentia; Ireland, Newfoundland and the Moesian terrane as Avalonia, Baltica, peri-Gondwanan Europe; global compilations are Unassigned.
